::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [after 1892]  
**From:** 70 Kensington Gardens Square  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell/20
:::

Dear Madam
I shall be out all day tomorrow, and from 11 o’clock both Friday and Saturday, and I go away on Saturday so I hardly like to propose your taking the trouble of calling so early

yours truly
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper.
